name: research_turn
description: Submit your research result and finish this turn.

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: <=25 lines: 3-5 core conclusions with [confidence] tags, the key evidence, and what you could NOT verify

parameters.name: report_path
parameters.description: path of the full report you already wrote, e.g. docs/sop/avenger_<slug>_mkt.md

parameters.name: file_requests
parameters.description: optional: up to 3 files to read before you submit (e.g. an earlier report you must not contradict)
